coverageNote.note: Hormel Foods operates ~50 manufacturing facilities, almost entirely in NA. We audited 27 representative sites.

account.dossierIntro: Hormel Foods runs the Spam, Skippy, and Planters network. 50 facilities; we audited 27. Fort Smith AR has 45 dock doors on 58 acres. Austin MN is 120 acres (the flagship Spam plant has been there since 1937). 5 of 27 audited sites are rail-served. 766 dock doors. YardFlow runs the shelf-stable, refrigerated, and frozen-meat flows as distinct protocols on one yard graph.
surprisingFindings: Austin MN is 120 acres of Spam. Hormel has been making the same SKU on the same site since 1937.
5 of 27 audited sites are rail-served. Inbound pork moves on rail; outbound canned meat ships on trucks.
1,609 trailer spots across 27 audited sites. Hormel runs heavy trailer density for shelf-stable CPG.

sites.name: Hormel Flagship Austin Plant - Austin MN
sites.dossierExcerpt:
The roster coordinates (43.68237, -92.968394, "ROOFTOP", address "1 Hormel
Place") point at the Hormel World Headquarters / R&D campus — a cluster of
multi-story office/lab buildings — not the production plant. Step-0 satellite
probing at z16-z17 around that point showed only office-scale buildings.

The actual flagship Austin processing plant (1.3M sq ft, ~1,900 employees,
SPAM / Cure 81 / bacon / pepperoni) is a sprawling industrial complex ~1.1 km
south, centered ~43.6765, -92.9665. Confirmed by: (a) z16-z17 satellite showing
a 10+ building manufacturing complex with dock banks and trailer yards;
(b) web research — the Hormel Austin Plant main gate is on 14th Ave NE
(CMac listing, phone 507-437-5293); (c) the Cedar River bounds the plant on the
west, 14th Ave NE / residential streets on the east, matching public records.
